newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume falls on higher prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume falls on higher prices.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange shrank to 356 kg on Friday from 1,375 kg on Thursday as physical demand from the free market faded in the face of higher prices, dealers said.

Gold closed up at $354.55 an ounce versus Thrusday's $348.80 due to rising world levels. It also leapt to 1,386,000 lira per gram from the previous 1,357,500 lira, with support from the Turkish lira's continuing weakness against the dollar.
The lira closed at 120,980 per dollar against 120,850 on Thursday.
Lower world prices had buoyed demand from the free market earlier this week amid falling world prices.
Of the total trade, 116 kg was made in the first session and 240 kg in the afternoon. 52 percent of the total was in dollar terms.
